seoSections.heading: RV workshop in Gatineau
seoSections.body: Clinique du VR receives RVs, travel trailers, boats and other recreational vehicles at its Gatineau workshop for repair, diagnostics, custom work, fiberglass, bodywork, paint, polishing, washing, brakes and axles.

seoSections.heading: Before you send a message
seoSections.body: If you have photos, signs of water intrusion, roof or seal details, 12 V / 120 V equipment, propane, solar, batteries, or layout goals, include them in your message.
